name: Photo Carousel Slideshow
summary: A set of 4 to 10 still images that the viewer swipes, with one line of text on each slide and a hook on the first slide. Instagram added carousels in 2017, and TikTok added photo mode in 2022.

philosophy.core_thesis: Slow the feed down: one idea on each still slide, one swipe at a time.
design_principles: Use a 4:5 frame of 1080 x 1350 px or a 9:16 frame of 1080 x 1920 px for every slide.
Make slide 1 the hook: a 72 px headline of 6 words or fewer.
Keep 1 idea and 1 line of 40 px text on each slide, with 64 px margins.
Use 5 to 10 slides and show the count as dots of 8 px at the bottom.
Repeat the same grid, colour and type on all slides so the set reads as one.
Cue the swipe with an arrow or a cut-off element at the right edge on slide 1.
End on a save or share prompt at 44 px with a 100% contrast button.
anti_patterns: A different layout on each slide

layout.grid_mechanics: A fixed grid of 12 columns with 64 px margins; the same text box on each slide; a dot indicator at 48 px from the bottom.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 40% to 50% of each slide is open; one image and one line of text.
layout.alignment_rules: Text is flush-left at the 64 px margin; the page number sits at the bottom right.
layout.container_geometry: Hard rectangle slides; 24 px radius on cards inside a slide; 8 px dots.

font_pairings.note: A serif headline with a neutral sans for the line of text.
A display serif for the hook slide.

hierarchy_rules: Use a display serif at 72 px for the hook only.
Use regular (400) sans at 40 px on content slides.
Use one accent colour for the key word.
Put the slide number in 24 px caps.

color.palette_structure: A paper white and ink base with one accent that repeats on every slide.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on paper gives 15:1; coral is for the key word at 44 px or larger, at 3.6:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat paper colour; photos with a 2 px inner frame.
color.light_and_shadow: Flat light; a 12 px soft shadow under a card only.

materiality.surface_simulation: Printed card stock and a photo print.
materiality.border_rules: A 2 px ink border on photo cards.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 12 px soft shadow under cards; no blur.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline 24 px icons for save, share and arrow.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Hand-drawn circles and arrows in the accent colour.

motion.transition_physics: The viewer swipes; a slide slides in 300 ms from the right; the audio loops at 15 s to 60 s on TikTok.
motion.hover_and_active: A tap on the right edge moves to the next slide in 300 ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels calm and in control, and reads at a slow pace.

avoid_when: The story needs motion or sound.

modifiers.how: Turn the slides into 0.5 s cuts with speed ramps.
Replace the slides with a talk to the camera.
Use a larger serif and wide margins on a white page.

pack.why: A thin, neutral outline family for save, share and arrow icons.

ground.why: The ground is plain paper, like a printed card in a stack.

tailwind.classes: rounded-none bg-[#1A1A1A] px-8 py-4 text-lg font-medium text-[#F6F2EA]
